name: Be Angry And Sin Not
overview: Scripture teaches that anger itself is not sinful but must be controlled and expressed righteously, as God is justly angry with the wicked (Psalms 7:11). Unrestrained anger leads to strife and transgression (Proverbs 29:22), and Jesus warns that anger without cause toward others brings judgment (Matthew 5:22). Believers are called to refrain from personal vengeance, trusting God’s righteous judgment instead (Romans 12:19), and to live worthy of their calling by walking in the Spirit rather than yielding to the works of the flesh (Galatians 5:19; Ephesians 4:1).
